verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a first-party marketing claim that Dynamics 365 Sales lets customers "automate business processes". It never describes triggers, automatic record updates, task creation, or notifications. The Web API items are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented trigger/event-based workflow builder, automatic record-update actions, automated task creation, automated notification actions, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: Build custom sales apps, automate business processes, and enrich seller experiences—all tailored to your unique business needs.
